basic_info.description: Presidio Laurel - rare luxury new construction in Presidio & Laurel Heights.  Beautifully appointed new condominium homes with modern designer finishes, including Taj Mahal stone counters, Riva white oak flooring, EcoSmart fireplaces, Miele appliances, Leicht cabinetry, Waterworks fixtures, Carrara & French Limestone.  3659 California is a top floor 2 Bedroom, 2 Bathroom home with north-facing open floor plan living/ dining/ kitchen and shared roof terrace. Windows in all directions and wonderful outlooks.  In-unit laundry.  Close to boutiques, restaurants, cafes of Laurel Village & Sacramento Street.  Leased parking secured and available nearby - two years of parking pre-paid by seller.  Easy transportation corridor via the #1 California line, and many other routes.
